- Fixture: Brighton & Hove Albion vs Crystal Palace, Premier League 2026-27, at the American Express Stadium on 2026-10-18. Football365 lists kickoff at 2pm BST, which is 13:00 UTC. If that is late, Flashscore is used, then [Sofascore](https://www.sofascore.com/football/match/brighton-and-hove-albion-crystal-palace/hsF). No URL was given in the criteria, and I could not fetch the ESPN, 11v11 or Wikipedia pages because the proxy refused the connection.

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-10-11 the match had not been played, so nothing settles the question yet. A Premier League international break falls between 2026-10-11 and the fixture.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- After 6 matches (before the break): Brighton were 3rd with 13 points, and Palace were nine places lower with 7 points. Football365 reports this, but its preview may have been published after the cutoff. The standings themselves were already fixed by 2026-10-11. [Football365](https://www.football365.com/match-preview/brighton-v-crystal-palace-prediction-preview)
- 2026-09-13: Brighton won 5-0 away at Coventry City. [Wikipedia season page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026%E2%80%9327_Brighton_%26_Hove_Albion_F.C._season)
- Brighton were unbeaten in the league going into the break, and Fabian Hürzeler is still manager.
- I could not confirm Brighton's result from the weekend before the break, or any team news or injuries for this fixture.
- Palace appear to be in a European competition, probably the Conference League, so they may have had a midweek fixture shortly before 2026-10-18. I could not confirm this.

## 4. Base rates
- Recent seasons of the M23 derby have been close, with many draws and Palace often doing well. I could not fetch a full head-to-head table, but the Brighton home win rate in this fixture has historically been around 30-45%.
- An Opta supercomputer preview of an earlier Brighton home game against Palace gave Brighton 50.0% to win and Palace 25.8%. The page is undated and may be from 2025-26. [The Analyst](https://theanalyst.com/?p=155445)
- In 2026-27 so far, Brighton have about 4 wins from 6 (13 points). Premier League home teams win about 43-46% of matches overall.
- Form gap: on points, Brighton (3rd, 13) are well ahead of Palace (7 points).

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold prices, and no bookmaker odds for this fixture published on or before 2026-10-11.
- Given the league positions and home advantage, a market would plausibly make Brighton the favourite. This is an inference, not a price I found.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- International break (about 2026-10-12 to 10-14): players could pick up injuries or travel fatigue.
- Possible Palace European fixture midweek, around 2026-10-15 (not confirmed).
- Pre-match press conferences and team news (about 2026-10-16 to 10-17).
- Kickoff on 2026-10-18 at 13:00 UTC; the result should be known by about 15:00 UTC.
